grammar.q:
Tim: What's the ____ today?
Amy: It's October thirtieth.
grammar.tip: 問幾月幾日 → What's the date?

grammar.q:
A: What day is it today?
B: It's ____.
grammar.tip: What day 問星期 → 答星期幾

grammar.q:
Jill: What's the date today?
Sara: It's ____ September 13.
grammar.tip: 單純敘述日期 It's + 日期，不加介系詞

grammar.q: Today is ____ June 6, and Dad's birthday is ____ June 15.
grammar.tip: Today is + 日期不加 on；be 在某日 → on

grammar.q: September is ____ month of the year.
grammar.tip: 序數當形容詞要加 the；nine → ninth

grammar.q: This is ____ first watch, and I like ____.
grammar.tip: 序數前加所有格；watch 單數 → 受格 it

grammar.q: My son's birthday is on ____.
grammar.tip: on + 某月某日；March 用 in

grammar.q: We can't wait to welcome a new year ____ New Year's Eve.
grammar.tip: 特定的日子（節日）前用 on

grammar.q: The magic show is on ____.
grammar.tip: on + 星期/日期；月份用 in，時刻用 at

grammar.q: Mother's Day is ____ next week. It's ____ May 12 this year.
grammar.tip: next week 前不加介系詞；日期前用 on

grammar.q:
A: What day is the Christmas party?
B: It's ____.
grammar.tip: What day 問星期 → this Friday

grammar.q:
Max: Mom, I'm very hungry.
Mom: Wash your hands ____, and you can eat an apple.
grammar.tip: first 當副詞「先」：先洗手

grammar.q: The month after May is ____.
grammar.tip: 五月之後是六月 June

grammar.q:
Tim: What's our ____ today, Mom?
Mom: How about McDonald's? I can't cook this evening.
grammar.tip: 晚餐吃什麼 → dinner

grammar.q: Christmas is on ____ twenty-fifth.
grammar.tip: 聖誕節在十二月二十五日

grammar.q:
Ben: ____ is the English test?
Olga: It's next Monday.
grammar.tip: 答時間 next Monday → 問何時 When

grammar.q: The kids are running ____ in the park.
grammar.tip: run around 到處跑

grammar.q: Let's ____ our thanks to Miss Lin on Teacher's Day.
grammar.tip: Let's + 原形動詞 → give

grammar.q:
Joe: I have a CD for Miss Lin. How ____ you, Amy?
Amy: I can make a cake.
grammar.tip: How about you? 那你呢？

grammar.q: You have a card, a cake, and a CD. I can put ____ in the box.
grammar.tip: 三樣東西 → 複數受格 them

grammar.q: The party is ____ this Saturday.
grammar.tip: this/next + 時間前不加介系詞

grammar.q:
A: What ____ is the party?
B: It's at 6:30 in the evening.
grammar.tip: 答 at 6:30 → 問幾點 What time

grammar.q: The party is ____ 6:30 ____ Saturday evening.
grammar.tip: 時刻用 at；某天的早晚用 on

grammar.q:
A: When is the concert?
B: It's ____ December 22.
grammar.tip: When 問句答「在某日」→ on + 日期

grammar.q: August is ____ eighth month of the year.
grammar.tip: 序數當形容詞前加 the

grammar.q:
A: What's the date today?
B: It's ____.
grammar.tip: 日期 = 月份 + 序數日

grammar.q: Today is my sister's ____ birthday.
grammar.tip: 21 → 十位基數 + 個位序數 twenty-first

grammar.q: June 9th = ____
grammar.tip: the + 序數 + of + 月份

grammar.q:
A: ____ is your birthday?
B: It's on June 20.
grammar.tip: 答 on June 20 → 問何時 When

grammar.q:
A: When is Christmas?
B: ____
grammar.tip: on + 日期，日用序數

grammar.q: Her birthday party is on ____.
grammar.tip: on + 某月某日 June 9th

grammar.q:
Lorna: ____ is Thanksgiving?
Cindy: It's on the fourth Thursday of November.
grammar.tip: 問節日在何時 → When

grammar.q: The game is on ____ Monday of every month.
grammar.tip: 第幾個星期一 → the + 序數

grammar.q: Mother's Day is ____ the ____ Sunday of May.
grammar.tip: 特定日用 on；第二個 → second

grammar.q:
Gina: What's today's date?
Ken: It's ____.
grammar.tip: 問日期 → 答月份 + 日

grammar.q: Thanksgiving is ____ November.
grammar.tip: 只有月份 → in + 月份

grammar.q: Let's meet in front of the school ____ 4 p.m.
grammar.tip: 時刻前用 at

grammar.q: December is the ____ month of the year.
grammar.tip: twelve → twelfth（ve 改 f）

grammar.q: My cousin is nine today. It's his ____ birthday.
grammar.tip: nine → ninth（去 e）

grammar.q: May is the ____ month of the year.
grammar.tip: five → fifth（ve 改 f）

grammar.q:
A: What's the date today?
B: It's October ____.
grammar.tip: 30 → y 改 ie + th → thirtieth

grammar.q:
A: Is Peter your first or second son?
B: He's my ____ son.
grammar.tip: 所有格 + 序數，不再加 the

grammar.q:
A: What are you doing?
B: I'm ____ dinner for my family.
grammar.tip: 現在進行式 be + V-ing

grammar.q: Look! The cow ____ running around.
grammar.tip: the cow 單數 → is + V-ing

grammar.q: Teddy the turkey: "Don't eat ____! I'm small and thin."
grammar.tip: 動詞 eat 後接受格 me

grammar.q:
Kim: When can we eat? I'm hungry.
Mom: ____. Let's give our thanks first.
grammar.tip: 祈使句用原形動詞 Wait

grammar.q: Jamie: My baby brother's birthday is ____ that day, too.
grammar.tip: on that day 在那一天

grammar.q: Yuki's birthday is the day ____ Thanksgiving.
grammar.tip: the day before... 在…的前一天

grammar.q:
A: What time is it?
B: ____
grammar.tip: What time 問幾點 → 答時刻

grammar.q: Sunday is ____ day of the week.
grammar.tip: 序數當形容詞要加 the
